pr_title: Replace WebSocketSharp with System.Net.WebSockets in GDAXBrokerage
pr_body:
#### Description
- Added new `WebSocketClientWrapper` class based on `System.Net.WebSockets.ClientWebSocket`
- Replaced usage of `WebSocketWrapper` with `WebSocketClientWrapper` in `GDAXBrokerage`

#### Related Issue
Closes #4324 

#### Motivation and Context
- Stability of brokerage implementation

#### Requires Documentation Change
No.

#### How Has This Been Tested?
- Local testing in both Windows and Linux/Docker + cloud testing

#### Types of changes
- [x] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [x] Refactor (non-breaking change which improves implementation)
- [ ] Performance (non-breaking change which improves performance. Please add associated performance test and results)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to change)
- [ ] Non-functional change (xml comments/documentation/etc)

#### Checklist:
- [x] My code follows the code style of this project.
- [x] I have read the **CONTRIBUTING** [document](https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [x] All new and existing tests passed.
- [x] My branch follows the naming convention `bug-<issue#>-<description>` or `feature-<issue#>-<description>`

https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/pull/4317

comments: Exception stacktrace messages are also coming at a very fast rate: over 30 MB of logs in 12 hours (websocket was disconnected about 10 times over that time period)...
Reverting back to an older Lean version with everything else staying the same restores a stable Coinbase Pro websocket operation, with occasional disconnects being quickly reconnected.
Thank you @multidis; we'll look into this more. @StefanoRaggi

@multidis
this issue seems related to the WebSocketSharp library we're using for CoinbasePro.
In #4317 we didn't update the library (it was only an update for the handling of order fills)

Do you know which LEAN version you were using before the upgrade?
Can you confirm that reverting to the LEAN version prior to the #4317 merge the issue persists?

@StefanoRaggi turns out the 2020-03-31 commit I am referring to also generates the stack overflow message and kills LEAN session after 15 min. Observed that after a longer testing. Seems more stable however than the master. Overall, the testing is fairly difficult and poorly reproducible. `WebSocketSharp.WebSocketFrame` is most commonly mentioned in megabytes of error log.

@multidis Thanks for the extensive testing, the `WebSocketSharp` library we are currently using has a few issues, I think we need to replace it with a more stable build or even replacing it with a different library.

`System.Net.WebSockets` indeed appears to be stable, thank you @StefanoRaggi for the fix!

Reconnects with the Coinbase Pro socket happen reliably so far, with clean logs:

review_comments: Should we call `OnClose()` here? The wrapping task will try to reconnect, that's expected?

> Should we call `OnClose()` here?

This message should be received by the client as a response to the Close request on L105,
OnClose should be called after the close handshake is completed on L120

> The wrapping task will try to reconnect, that's expected?

Correct
